President Appoints New Governors for Six Indian States

President Droupadi Murmu has appointed new governors for six states, including Tamil Nadu and Kerala. Rajendra Arlekar will serve as the full-time Governor of Tamil Nadu, and Om Prakash Mathur has been appointed as the Governor of Kerala. These appointments will take effect from the dates the individuals assume charge. The reshuffle also includes new governors for Karnataka, Odisha, Uttarakhand, and Sikkim.
